title: Tech Note: Chart Wizard with 4D View Pro (R2)
author: Nhat Do, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: VP Export to object / VP IMPORT FROM OBJECT

historical_commentary.text: 4D View Pro/SpreadJS remains the current spreadsheet engine, and driving its JS API via WA Evaluate JavaScript is still a valid, supported escape hatch for advanced features. However, the specific cross-platform export workaround here — relying on the third-party Xpdf executable to convert PDF to PNG on Windows because 4D's PDF handling was macOS-only — is the kind of gap that later 4D releases have targeted for improvement; developers today should check whether current 4D versions offer native PDF/picture export parity across platforms before adopting this specific workaround, as it may no longer be necessary.
related_updates: 4D View Pro/SpreadJS remains current; the Xpdf-based PDF-to-PNG Windows workaround may be unnecessary in later 4D releases if native cross-platform picture export has since improved — verify against current documentation before reusing this workaround.
